title: Harden MeshExtractionResult against malformed topology
description: Make MeshExtractionResult's public operations total over malformed manually-created data. Triangle storage must contain complete triangles, every index must address an existing vertex, and vertex positions must be finite before topology-dependent operations execute. ComputeAngleWeightedNormals and ToUnityMesh should share one validation boundary so malformed input consistently produces DomainException rather than leaking IndexOutOfRangeException, Unity mesh errors, or NaN normals. Keep extraction-path behavior unchanged for valid results.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Implemented a single MeshExtractionResult.ValidateTopology() boundary and call it from both ComputeAngleWeightedNormals() and ToUnityMesh(). It rejects null storage, incomplete triangle lists, out-of-range/negative indices, and non-finite vertices. Added MeshExtractionResultTests covering each malformed case and a valid normal result. No Unity execution was performed in this harness.
